summary.headline: Planetary Zones and House Calculations
summary.text: House-position calculations continue with examples for the eleventh, second, and third houses and their corresponding houses. Chapter Three introduces the zones of the seven planets, planetary and lunar epicycles, the appearance and disappearance of the five wandering planets, and crescent sightings, distinguishing eccentric, deferent, and epicycle zones.
